xwikidoc.content: {{velocity}} ## Marks a violation of a documentation page as a false positive, or reinstates it, then goes back to the violations of ## the page. The script service checks that the current user is a wiki administrator. #if ($request.method == 'POST' && $services.csrf.isTokenValid($request.form_token) && "$!request.page" != '') #set ($violationPageReference = $services.model.resolveDocument($request.page)) #set ($violationNumber = $numbertool.toNumber($request.number)) #if ($violationNumber) #if ($request.violationAction == 'markFalsePositive' && "$!request.scope" != '') ## Mark the violations of the same rule, i.e. reported by the same check with the same message, in the chosen ## page and in the pages located under it, which include the current page. #set ($violation = $xwiki.getDocument($violationPageReference).getObject('DocApp.Code.DocumentationViolationClass', $violationNumber.intValue())) #if ($violation) #set ($discard = $services.documentation.markFalsePositives("$!violation.getValue('check')", $violation.getValue('message'), $services.model.resolveDocument($request.scope), $request.reason)) #end #elseif ($request.violationAction == 'markFalsePositive') #set ($discard = $services.documentation.markFalsePositive($violationPageReference, $violationNumber.intValue(), $request.reason)) #elseif ($request.violationAction == 'unmarkFalsePositive') #set ($discard = $services.documentation.unmarkFalsePositive($violationPageReference, $violationNumber.intValue())) #end #end $response.sendRedirect("$xwiki.getURL($violationPageReference)#documentation.tab") #end {{/velocity}}
